import re

def slugify_old(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")

def slugify_new(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")

print("Old:", repr(slugify_old("  a   b  ")))
print("New:", repr(slugify_new("  a   b  ")))

# Debug the regex step by step
text = "  a   b  "
text = text.strip().lower()
print(f"After strip: {repr(text)}")
text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
print(f"After spaces normalization: {repr(text)}")
result = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
print(f"After punctuation replacement: {repr(result)}")
result = result.strip("-")
print(f"After strip hyphens: {repr(result)}")

print()
text2 = "C++ rocks!"
text2 = text2.strip().lower()
print(f"After strip: {repr(text2)}")
text2 = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text2)
print(f"After spaces normalization: {repr(text2)}")
result2 = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text2)
print(f"After punctuation replacement: {repr(result2)}")
result2 = result2.strip("-")
print(f"After strip hyphens: {repr(result2)}")
EOF
